sql.value: SELECT DISTINCT ffs.`id`, ffs.`code`, ffs.full_name, ffs.parent_id, ffs.query_code, ffs.unit, ffs.leaf, CONCAT(ffs.`code`, ' ', ffs.`name`) as name FROM fxy_financial_balance AS ffb INNER JOIN fxy_financial_subject AS ffs ON ffs.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id AND ffs.id = ffb.subject_id WHERE ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffs.status = 1 #[@if(:showNumPrice==true) and length(ffs.unit) > 0] #[AND ffb.currency_id = :currencyId] #[AND ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = :detailId] #[AND ffb.date BETWEEN :start AND :end] #[AND ffs.`level` BETWEEN :levelStart AND :levelEnd] #[@if(:subjectStart!=null && :subjectEnd!=null) AND ffs.query_code BETWEEN :subjectStart and :subjectEnd] #[@if(:subjectStart!=null && :subjectEnd==null) AND ffs.query_code >= :subjectStart] #[@if(:subjectEnd!=null && :subjectStart==null) AND ffs.query_code <= :subjectEnd] and ( ffb.begin_balance <> 0 or ffb.begin_balance_for <> 0 or ffb.year_total <> 0 or ffb.credit <> 0 or ffb.debit <> 0 or ffb.year_total_credit <> 0 or ffb.year_total_debit <> 0 or ffb.year_total_debit_for <> 0 or ffb.year_total_credit_for <> 0 or ffb.end_balance <> 0 or ffb.end_balance_for <> 0 ) order by ffs.query_code

SELECT DISTINCT ffb.auxiliary_detail_id, ffad.details, ffb.subject_id FROM fxy_financial_balance AS ffb INNER JOIN fxy_financial_subject AS ffs ON ffs.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id AND ffs.id = ffb.subject_id INNER JOIN fxy_financial_auxiliary_detail AS ffad ON ffad.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id AND ffad.id = ffb.auxiliary_detail_id WHERE ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id <> 0 #[and ffs.code like :subjectCode] #[AND ffb.currency_id = :currencyId] #[AND ffb.date BETWEEN :start AND :end] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].categoryType', :categoryType) = 1] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].categoryId', :categoryId) = 1] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].value', :detailId) = 1]

SELECT DISTINCT ffb.auxiliary_detail_id, ffb.subject_id,ffs.query_code FROM fxy_financial_balance AS ffb INNER JOIN fxy_financial_subject AS ffs ON ffs.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id AND ffs.id = ffb.subject_id INNER JOIN fxy_financial_auxiliary_detail AS ffad ON ffad.account_sets_id = ffb.account_sets_id AND ffad.id = ffb.auxiliary_detail_id WHERE ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id <> 0 and ffs.leaf = 1 #[and ffs.code like :subjectCode] #[AND ffb.subject_id = :subjectId] #[AND ffb.currency_id = :currencyId] #[AND ffb.date BETWEEN :start AND :end] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].categoryType', :categoryType) = 1] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].categoryId', :categoryId) = 1] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].value', :detailId) = 1] order by ffs.query_code

SELECT ffad.id as id FROM fxy_financial_auxiliary_detail AS ffad WHERE ffad.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].categoryType', :categoryType) = 1] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].categoryId', :categoryId) = 1] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].value', :detailId) = 1]

SELECT ffad.id as id, ffad.details FROM fxy_financial_auxiliary_detail AS ffad WHERE ffad.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffad.id in (:auxiliaryDetailId) #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].categoryType', :categoryType) = 1] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].categoryId', :categoryId) = 1] #[AND json_contains(ffad.details -> '$[*].value', :detailId) = 1]

SELECT ffvd.`subject_id`, ffs.full_name as subjectName, ffs.name as subjectSortName, ffs.code as subjectCode, ffv.word, ffv.code, ffvd.voucher_id, ffvd.summary, ffvd.debit_amount as debit_amount, ffvd.credit_amount as credit_amount, ffvd.debit_num as debit_num, ffvd.credit_num as credit_num, ffvd.num as num, ffvd.price as price, ffc.name as currency, ffc.exchange_rate as currencyRate, ffvd.currency_id, ffvd.voucher_date FROM fxy_financial_voucher_details AS ffvd left join fxy_financial_currency AS ffc on ffc.account_sets_id = ffvd.account_sets_id and ffc.id = ffvd.currency_id INNER JOIN fxy_financial_voucher AS ffv ON ffvd.account_sets_id = ffv.account_sets_id AND ffv.id = ffvd.voucher_id INNER JOIN fxy_financial_subject AS ffs ON ffvd.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id AND ffs.id = ffvd.subject_id WHERE ffvd.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId #[and ffvd.subject_id in (select ffs.id from fxy_financial_subject ffs where ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffs.code like concat((select code from fxy_financial_subject ffs where ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffs.id= :subjectId),'%') and ffs.leaf = 1)] #[and ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id in (:detailIds)] #[and ffvd.summary like :summary] #[and ffvd.currency_id = :currencyId] #[AND ffvd.voucher_date BETWEEN :start AND :end] order by ffv.code, ffvd.voucher_date

SELECT sum(ffb.year_total_credit) as credit, sum(ffb.year_total_debit) as debit, sum(ffb.end_balance) as end_balance, sum(ffb.end_balance_for) as end_balance_for, sum(ffb.end_credit_quantity) as credit_num, sum(CAST(ffb.year_total_credit AS decimal)) / sum(CAST(ffb.end_credit_quantity AS decimal)) as credit_price, sum(ffb.end_debit_quantity) as debit_num, sum(CAST(ffb.year_total_debit AS decimal)) / sum(CAST(ffb.end_debit_quantity AS decimal)) as debit_price, sum(ffb.end_quantity) as num, sum(CAST(ffb.end_balance AS decimal)) / sum(CAST(ffb.end_quantity AS decimal)) as price FROM fxy_financial_balance AS ffb WHERE ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId #[and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id in (:detailIds)] #[and ffb.subject_id = :subjectId] #[and ffb.currency_id = :currencyId] and ffb.year = :year and ffb.period = :month limit 1

SELECT ffb.year_total_credit as credit, ffb.year_total_credit_for as credit_for, ffb.year_total_debit as debit, ffb.year_total_debit_for as debit_for, ffb.begin_balance as end_balance, ffb.begin_balance_for as end_balance_for, ffb.year_total_credit_quantity as credit_num, CAST(ffb.year_total_credit AS decimal) / CAST(ffb.year_total_credit_quantity AS decimal) as credit_price, ffb.year_total_debit_quantity as debit_num, CAST(ffb.year_total_debit AS decimal) / CAST(ffb.year_total_debit_quantity AS decimal) as debit_price, ffb.begin_quantity as num, CAST(ffb.begin_balance AS decimal) / CAST(ffb.begin_quantity AS decimal) as price FROM fxy_financial_balance_initial AS ffb WHERE ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId #[and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id in (:detailIds)] #[ and ffb.subject_id = :subjectId] #[and ffb.currency_id = :currencyId] limit 1

SELECT ffb.year_total_credit, ffb.year_total_credit_for, ffb.year_total_debit, ffb.year_total_debit_for, ffb.begin_balance, ffb.begin_balance_for FROM fxy_financial_balance AS ffb WHERE ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.subject_id = :subjectId and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id in (:detailIds) and ffb.currency_id = :currencyId and ffb.year = :year and ffb.period = :month limit 1

SELECT ffb.year_total_credit, ffb.year_total_credit_for, ffb.year_total_debit, ffb.year_total_debit_for, ffb.begin_balance, ffb.begin_balance_for FROM fxy_financial_balance_initial AS ffb WHERE ffb.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.subject_id = :subjectId and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id in (:detailIds) and ffb.currency_id = :currencyId limit 1

SELECT ffs.`code`, ffs.`full_name` as subjectName, ffs.`unit` as unit, ffb.subject_id, ffb.begin_balance, ffb.begin_balance_for, ffb.end_balance, ffb.end_balance_for, ffb.credit_for, ffb.credit, ffb.debit, ffb.debit_for, ffb.year_total_debit, ffb.year_total_credit, ffb.year_total_debit_for, ffb.year_total_credit_for, ffs.balance_direction, ffb.begin_quantity, CAST(ffb.begin_balance AS decimal) / CAST(ffb.begin_quantity AS decimal) as begin_price, CAST(ffb.end_balance AS decimal) / CAST(ffb.end_quantity AS decimal) as end_price, ffb.end_quantity, ffb.year_total_quantity, ffb.year_total_credit_quantity, ffb.year_total_debit_quantity, ffb.debit_quantity, ffb.credit_quantity, ffb.end_debit_quantity, ffb.end_credit_quantity, date_format(ffb.date, '%Y年%m月') as date FROM fxy_financial_balance AS ffb INNER JOIN fxy_financial_subject AS ffs ON ffb.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id AND ffb.subject_id = ffs.id WHERE ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.subject_id in (:subjectId) and ffb.currency_id = :currencyId and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = :detailId #[AND ffb.date BETWEEN :start AND :end] order by ffs.query_code, ffb.date

SELECT 'begin' as type, ffs.`code` as subjectCode, ffs.`leaf` as leaf, ffs.`query_code`, ffs.`name` as subjectName, ffb.subject_id, ffb.subject_id as treeId, ffs.parent_id as parentTreeId, ffb.auxiliary_detail_id, 0 as credit_for, 0 as credit, 0 as debit, 0 as debit_for, 0 as credit_quantity, 0 as debit_quantity, 0 as year_total_debit, 0 as year_total_credit, 0 as year_total_debit_for, 0 as year_total_credit_for, 0 as year_total_debit_quantity, 0 as year_total_credit_quantity, ffb.begin_balance, ffb.begin_balance_for, ffb.begin_quantity, 0 as end_balance_for, 0 as end_balance, 0 as end_quantity, ffs.balance_direction FROM fxy_financial_balance AS ffb INNER JOIN fxy_financial_subject AS ffs ON ffb.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id AND ffb.subject_id = ffs.id WHERE ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId #[and ffb.subject_id in (:subjectId)] and ffb.currency_id = :currencyId #[and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = :detailId] #[and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id in (:detailIds)] ffs.`query_code`, ffs.`name` as subjectName, ffb.subject_id, ffb.subject_id as treeId, ffs.parent_id as parentTreeId, ffb.auxiliary_detail_id, sum(ffb.credit_for) as credit_for, sum(ffb.credit) as credit, sum(ffb.debit) as debit, sum(ffb.debit_for) as debit_for, sum(ffb.credit_quantity) as credit_quantity, sum(ffb.debit_quantity) as debit_quantity, 0 as year_total_debit, 0 as year_total_credit, end_balance_for, 0 as end_balance, 0 as end_quantity, ffs.balance_direction FROM fxy_financial_balance AS ffb INNER JOIN fxy_financial_subject AS ffs ON ffb.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id AND ffb.subject_id = ffs.id WHERE ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId #[and ffb.subject_id in (:subjectId)] and ffb.currency_id = :currencyId #[and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = :detailId] #[and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id in (:detailIds)] #[@if(:auxiliary==true) and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id <> 0] #[AND ffb.date BETWEEN :start AND :end] group by ffb.subject_id, ffb.auxiliary_detail_id, ffb.currency_id union all SELECT 'end' as type, ffs.`code` as subjectCode, ffs.`leaf` as leaf, ffs.`query_code`, ffs.`name` as subjectName, ffb.subject_id, ffb.subject_id as treeId, ffs.parent_id as ffb.year_total_credit as year_total_credit, ffb.year_total_debit_for as year_total_debit_for, ffb.year_total_credit_for as year_total_credit_for, ffb.year_total_debit_quantity as year_total_debit_quantity, ffb.year_total_credit_quantity as year_total_credit_quantity, 0 as begin_balance, 0 as begin_balance_for, 0 as begin_quantity, ffb.end_balance_for, ffb.end_balance, ffb.end_quantity, ffs.balance_direction FROM fxy_financial_balance AS ffb INNER JOIN fxy_financial_subject AS ffs ON ffb.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id AND ffb.subject_id = ffs.id WHERE ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId #[and ffb.subject_id in (:subjectId)] and ffb.currency_id = :currencyId #[and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = :detailId] #[@if(:auxiliary==true) and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id <> 0] #[ and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id in (:detailIds)] and ffb.year = :eyear and ffb.period = :eperiod order by query_code

SELECT ffs.`code` as subjectCode, ffs.`query_code`, ffs.`name` as subjectName, ffs.leaf as leaf, ffb.subject_id, ffb.subject_id as treeId, ffs.parent_id as parentTreeId, ffb.auxiliary_detail_id, ffb.credit_for, ffb.credit, ffb.debit, ffb.debit_for, ffb.year_total_debit, ffb.year_total_credit, ffb.year_total_debit_for, ffb.year_total_credit_for, ffb.year_total_debit_quantity, ffb.year_total_credit_quantity, ffb.credit_quantity, ffb.debit_quantity, ffb.begin_balance, ffb.begin_balance_for, ffb.begin_quantity, ffb.end_balance_for, ffb.end_balance, ffb.end_quantity, ffs.balance_direction, ffb.id FROM fxy_financial_balance AS ffb INNER JOIN fxy_financial_subject AS ffs ON ffb.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id AND ffb.subject_id = ffs.id WHERE ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId #[and ffb.subject_id in (:subjectId)] and ffb.currency_id = :currencyId #[and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = :detailId] #[@if(:auxiliary==true) and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id <> 0] #[and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id in (:detailIds)] and ffb.year = :year and ffb.period = :period order by ffs.query_code

SELECT ffs.`code` as subjectCode, ffs.`query_code`, ffs.`full_name` as subjectName, ffb.subject_id, ffs.unit, ffb.subject_id as treeId, ffs.parent_id as parentTreeId, ffb.auxiliary_detail_id, sum(ffb.credit_for) as credit_for, sum(ffb.credit) as credit, sum(ffb.debit) as debit, sum(ffb.debit_for) as debit_for, sum(ffb.credit_quantity) as credit_quantity, sum(ffb.debit_quantity) as debit_quantity FROM fxy_financial_balance AS ffb INNER JOIN fxy_financial_subject AS ffs ON ffb.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id AND ffb.subject_id = ffs.id WHERE ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffb.subject_id in (:subjectId) and ffs.level = 1 #[and ffb.currency_id = :currencyId] and ffb.auxiliary_detail_id = :detailId #[AND ffb.date BETWEEN :start AND :end] group by ffs.`code`, ffs.`query_code`, ffs.`full_name`, ffb.subject_id, ffs.unit, ffb.subject_id, ffs.parent_id, ffb.auxiliary_detail_id having sum(ffb.debit) <> 0 or sum(ffb.credit) <> 0 or sum(ffb.credit_for) <> 0 or sum(ffb.debit_for) <> 0 order by ffs.query_code

SELECT count(ffv.id) vcount, sum(ffv.receipt_num) rcount FROM fxy_financial_voucher AS ffv where ffv.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffv.id in (select ffvd.voucher_id from fxy_financial_voucher_details ffvd where ffvd.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId #[AND ffvd.subject_id in (:subjectId)] #[AND ffvd.voucher_date BETWEEN :start AND :end] )

select date_format(ffv.voucher_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as voucherDate, ffvd.voucher_id, concat(ffv.word, '-', ffv.code) as word, ffvd.summary, coalesce(ffu.real_name, ffu.nickname) userName, coalesce(ffau.real_name, ffau.nickname) auditName, ffs.full_name as subjectName, ffs.code as subjectCode, ffvd.subject_id, ffvd.debit_amount, ffvd.debit_amount_for, ffvd.credit_amount, ffvd.credit_amount_for, ffvd.num, ffvd.debit_num, ffvd.credit_num, ffvd.num, ffv.receipt_num, ffv.remark from fxy_financial_voucher_details ffvd left join fxy_financial_voucher ffv on ffvd.account_sets_id = ffv.account_sets_id and ffvd.voucher_id = ffv.id left join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffvd.account_sets_id = ffs.account_sets_id and ffvd.subject_id = ffs.id left join fxy_financial_user ffu on ffv.create_member = ffu.id left join fxy_financial_user ffau on ffv.audit_member_id = ffau.id where ffvd.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId #[and ffvd.subject_id = :subjectId] #[and ffv.create_member = :createMember] #[and ffvd.summary like :summary] #[and ffv.word = :word] #[and (ffvd.debit_amount between :amountStart and :amountEnd or ffvd.credit_amount between :amountStart and :amountEnd)] #[and ffv.code between :codeStart and :codeEnd] #[AND ffv.voucher_date BETWEEN :start AND :end] #[@if(:sort == 'code' ) order by ffv.code] #[@if(:sort == 'voucher_date' ) order by ffv.voucher_date,ffv.word,ffv.code]
